commandDescription: Bundle record data and one-click migration script as an unlocked package version in Dev Hub
inputDirFlagDescription: directory which includes input data files in CSV
targetObjectsFlagDescription: list of object names to include in loading
ignoreObjectsFlagDescription: list of object names to exclude from loading
mappingObjectsFlagDescription: list of object and key field name pair to map to existing records (e.g. User:Email,RecordType:DeveloperName
ignoreFieldsFlagDescription: list of object.field path to exclude from loading (e.g. Account.OwnerId,OpportunityLineItem.TotalPrice)
defaultNamespaceFlagDescription: developer namespace prefix for managed packages
packageIdFlagDescription: ID (starts with 0Ho) of the existing unlocked package in Dev Hub to add the version to. A new unlocked package is created when omitted
packageNameFlagDescription: name of the unlocked package to create (ignored when --packageid is given)
versionNumberFlagDescription: version number of the package version in major.minor.patch.build format. Use NEXT as the build number to take the next available one
versionNameFlagDescription: name of the package version (defaults to the version number without the build number)
installationKeyFlagDescription: installation key for key-protected package. The package version is installable without a key when omitted
waitFlagDescription: number of minutes to wait for the package version creation
